metadata.description: Curated August 2026 source set for measuring coding assistants and coding agents across adoption, delivery, quality, ROI, experience, and agent-execution outcomes.

foundational_research.name: DORA Research Hub
foundational_research.description: Primary home for DORA reports and measurement frameworks.
foundational_research.relevance: Top-level source for engineering performance research and current AI-related report links.

foundational_research.name: DORA 2025: AI-Assisted Software Development
foundational_research.description: DORA's 2025 dedicated report on AI-assisted software development (Google Cloud). Covers how AI affects code quality, flow, delivery throughput, and delivery stability.
foundational_research.relevance: Primary 2025/2026 framing for conditional AI impact rather than default optimism. Use this URL for the AI-specific report; the dora.dev hub links the broader annual report.

foundational_research.name: DORA 2025: AI Capability Model
foundational_research.description: Capability model describing the organizational conditions that make AI helpful rather than disruptive.
foundational_research.relevance: Useful for separating tool usage from organization readiness and AI-accessibility.

foundational_research.name: DORA 2026: ROI of AI-Assisted Software Development
foundational_research.description: DORA's 2026 follow-up report (dated 2026.01, widely covered April-May 2026) providing a financial framework for AI investment ROI. Introduces the J-Curve adoption model (learning curve, verification tax, downstream process friction), a scenario-based ROI methodology (conservative/realistic/optimistic), and an 'instability tax' finding: AI adoption raises individual effectiveness and code quality but also change-failure rate in the report's illustrative model (5% to 6%). Also finds AI yields 35-40% gains on simple tasks vs. ~10% on complex legacy code.
foundational_research.relevance: Distinct from the 2025 DORA AI report — cite separately. Directly reinforces this skill's scenario-planning and task-complexity-segmentation rules in roi-framework.md and benchmarking-methodology.md. Treat the illustrative ~39% first-year ROI figure as a vendor scenario model, not a transferable benchmark.

foundational_research.name: SPACE Framework: A Multidimensional View of Developer Productivity
foundational_research.description: Foundational framework covering satisfaction, performance, activity, communication, and efficiency.
foundational_research.relevance: Prevents over-indexing on raw throughput when evaluating AI tools.

foundational_research.name: METR: Early 2025 AI on Experienced Open-Source Developers (RCT)
foundational_research.description: Randomized controlled trial (data Feb–Jun 2025, published 2025-07-10) on realistic open-source tasks with experienced developers. Found participants were ~19% SLOWER with early-2025 AI tools, contrary to developer self-predictions.
foundational_research.relevance: Primary counterweight to 'AI always speeds development up' claims; establishes RCT baseline for the early-2025 tooling generation.

foundational_research.name: METR 2026 Update: Changing Developer Productivity Experiment Design
foundational_research.description: METR update (2026-02-24) stating they believe developers are likely more sped up in early 2026 than early-2025 estimates suggested, but noting their new experiment gives an unreliable signal because 30–50% of participating developers declined to submit tasks they didn't want to do without AI (selection bias).
foundational_research.relevance: Critical for any claim about AI productivity trajectories into 2026: signals likely improvement but with significant methodological caveats. Do not cite as proof of productivity gains without flagging the selection bias.

foundational_research.name: METR May 2026 Self-Reported AI Productivity Survey
foundational_research.description: Survey of 349 technical workers (87 engineers, 71 researchers, 129 academics/PhD students, 48 founders/managers), conducted Feb–Apr 2026, published 2026-05-11. Median self-reported value-of-work change: 1.4–2x. METR notes significant skepticism: their 2025 RCT found participants overestimated AI time effects by 40 percentage points on average.
foundational_research.relevance: Use when discussing self-reported vs. controlled productivity data. Establishes 2026 trajectory context but must not be cited as controlled evidence of gains. Pair with METR 2025 RCT for balanced framing.

foundational_research.name: Evaluating the Impact of AGENTS.md Files on LLM-Coding Agents
foundational_research.description: Study of how repository-level agent instruction files affect cost and task performance.
foundational_research.relevance: Use when discussing context engineering as a moderator rather than a guaranteed lift.

foundational_research.name: GitHub Copilot RCT (Peng et al. 2023)
foundational_research.description: Randomized study often cited for Copilot productivity gains on constrained tasks.
foundational_research.relevance: Still useful, but should be interpreted as narrower than current agentic workflows.

foundational_research.name: Productivity Assessment of Neural Code Completion
foundational_research.description: Study introducing persistence-oriented metrics for code completion usefulness.
foundational_research.relevance: Useful for replacing naive acceptance-rate-only interpretations.

foundational_research.name: SlopCodeBench: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Degrade Over Long-Horizon Iterative Tasks
foundational_research.description: March 2026 preprint introducing evolving-spec, carried-workspace coding-agent evaluation and trajectory-level structural-erosion and verbosity signals.
foundational_research.relevance: Supports extension-robustness scorecards, checkpoint quality slopes, and late-checkpoint cost/review measurement. Do not transfer paper averages into organizational targets or causal ROI claims.

adoption_and_sentiment.name: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025
adoption_and_sentiment.description: Large annual developer survey with AI adoption and sentiment data.
adoption_and_sentiment.relevance: Useful for directional benchmarking on awareness, usage, and trust.

adoption_and_sentiment.name: JetBrains Developer Ecosystem Survey 2025
adoption_and_sentiment.description: Developer ecosystem survey with IDE, workflow, and AI assistant adoption data.
adoption_and_sentiment.relevance: Cross-checks GitHub- or ChatGPT-centric usage assumptions.

adoption_and_sentiment.name: GitHub Octoverse 2025
adoption_and_sentiment.description: GitHub's annual report with platform-level development and AI trends.
adoption_and_sentiment.relevance: Good directional source for broad platform usage shifts, not causal ROI claims.

adoption_and_sentiment.name: Faros AI Engineering Report 2026
adoption_and_sentiment.description: Organizational telemetry (not RCT) from 22,000 developers across 4,000 teams. Key figures: average PR size +51.3%; files touched per developer per month +149.9%; PRs merged without review +31.3%; lead time commit to production +480.4%; throughput (epics per developer) approximately +66%; incidents per PR approximately +243%. Reflects throughput-vs-quality divergence at scale.
adoption_and_sentiment.relevance: Use when illustrating throughput-vs-quality divergence. The PR-merge-without-review (+31.3%) and lead-time (+480.4%) figures are operationally significant — do not cite only throughput. Vendor telemetry, not RCT.

adoption_and_sentiment.name: GitClear: AI and Code Quality Analysis
adoption_and_sentiment.description: Large-scale code-churn and reuse analysis focused on AI-assisted code quality patterns.
adoption_and_sentiment.relevance: Useful caution source for rework, churn, and retained-quality discussions.

operator_content.name: AI tools are overdelivering: results from our large-scale AI productivity survey | Lenny's Newsletter
operator_content.description: Large-scale survey (1,750 respondents) on AI productivity impact across PMs, engineers, designers, and founders. Covers time savings, quality perception, role-specific patterns, and reported downsides.
operator_content.relevance: Independent cross-role productivity data useful for benchmarking self-reported AI impact alongside controlled studies.

operator_content.name: How to measure AI developer productivity in 2025 | Nicole Forsgren (Lenny's Podcast)
operator_content.description: Nicole Forsgren (creator of DORA and SPACE frameworks) discusses current approaches to measuring AI developer productivity, gaps in existing metrics, and practical guidance for engineering leaders.
operator_content.relevance: Direct bridge between DORA/SPACE frameworks and AI-era measurement; from the primary author of both frameworks.

agent_evaluation.name: OpenAI SWE-Lancer
agent_evaluation.description: OpenAI benchmark and evaluation framing for freelance-style software engineering tasks.
agent_evaluation.relevance: Better fit for agentic software work than narrow completion-only benchmarks.

agent_evaluation.name: RE-Bench
agent_evaluation.description: Benchmark focused on realistic and economically meaningful software engineering work.
agent_evaluation.relevance: Useful for benchmark-to-production gap discussions in agent evaluations.

agent_evaluation.name: GitHub Blog: Validating Agentic Behavior
agent_evaluation.description: Discussion of practical validation for nondeterministic agentic behavior in coding workflows.
agent_evaluation.relevance: Good support for treating benchmark wins as insufficient without workflow-level validation and production evidence.

measurement_tool_docs.name: GitHub Copilot Admin Metrics
measurement_tool_docs.description: Current GitHub documentation for Copilot metrics, entitlements, and admin measurement.
measurement_tool_docs.relevance: Primary first-party reference for GitHub Copilot adoption and usage definitions.

measurement_tool_docs.name: ChatGPT Enterprise and Edu User Analytics
measurement_tool_docs.description: OpenAI documentation for ChatGPT workspace analytics.
measurement_tool_docs.relevance: Useful when measuring workspace adoption separately from API-driven coding workflows.

measurement_tool_docs.name: Amazon Q Developer
measurement_tool_docs.description: Official Amazon Q Developer landing page replacing historical CodeWhisperer references.
measurement_tool_docs.relevance: Use for current naming and product-surface references instead of legacy CodeWhisperer URLs.

measurement_tool_docs.name: OpenTelemetry Documentation
measurement_tool_docs.relevance: Use when instrumenting custom events, traces, and workflow metadata for internal AI coding systems.

measurement_tool_docs.name: PostHog Documentation
measurement_tool_docs.relevance: Useful for instrumenting internal AI workflow events and experiments.

measurement_tool_docs.name: Apache DevLake
measurement_tool_docs.description: Open-source engineering metrics platform with DORA support.
measurement_tool_docs.relevance: Useful for team-level delivery instrumentation and baselining.

platform_and_practice.name: DX Platform
platform_and_practice.description: Developer experience platform and survey methodology vendor.
platform_and_practice.relevance: Useful for survey design patterns and DX language, but treat benchmarking claims as vendor evidence.

platform_and_practice.name: DX Core 4: Developer Productivity Measurement Framework
platform_and_practice.description: DX's four-dimension developer productivity framework. Covers speed, effectiveness, quality, and impact. A framework for measuring holistic developer productivity beyond narrow throughput metrics.
platform_and_practice.relevance: Use when the team needs a structured measurement model that goes beyond DORA delivery metrics. Treat specific benchmark figures as vendor evidence pending independent replication.

platform_and_practice.name: LinearB Engineering Benchmarks
platform_and_practice.description: Benchmark content for delivery metrics and engineering analytics.
platform_and_practice.relevance: Useful for directional comparison only; not a substitute for internal controls.

platform_and_practice.name: Swarmia Engineering Metrics
platform_and_practice.description: Engineering metrics and workflow commentary from a vendor platform.
platform_and_practice.relevance: Useful for implementation ideas, but treat performance claims as vendor evidence.

platform_and_practice.name: Grafana Dashboards
platform_and_practice.description: Visualization catalog for dashboards and engineering telemetry.
platform_and_practice.relevance: Useful for packaging delivery and quality metrics once definitions are stable.

platform_and_practice.name: SonarQube
platform_and_practice.description: Static analysis and code quality platform.
platform_and_practice.relevance: Useful as a quality-side measurement input when tracking AI-generated or AI-assisted code.
